rules.description: Checks that the latest date is identical across all 7 ERA5 monthly StatVars.
Checks that historical baseline observations from 1979-01 are included.
Checks that the latest observation date is within the last 3 months.
Checks that all 7 ERA5 monthly StatVars cover >= 14350 places and differ by at most 1 historical coastal place.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_statvars, MIN(NumPlaces) AS min_places, MAX(NumPlaces) AS max_places FROM stats
